title: WHY THIS PEACOCK SHAKES ITS GIANT FEATHER FAN
caption: Why do peacocks shake those incredible feathers? 🦚 #Peacock #Peafowl #AnimalBehavior #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Why does this Indian peacock shake a giant fan of feathers at another bird?
narration_timeline.scene: Start on a confirmed male peacock displaying directly toward a peahen.

narration_timeline.text: He spreads his long train when a peahen is nearby, exposing its eye-like spots.
narration_timeline.scene: Show the expanded train and peahen without implying every bird in frame is courting.

narration_timeline.text: Then he rattles the feathers rapidly, turning the display into a vibrating performance.
narration_timeline.scene: Show actual peacock courtship movement and train shaking.

narration_timeline.text: Those moving feathers can rustle and shimmer as their tiny structures catch the light.
narration_timeline.scene: Show a close train view while explaining shimmer, without fabricated microscopic imagery.

narration_timeline.text: This is courtship, not a threat. A peahen may inspect the display before choosing a mate.
narration_timeline.scene: Return to an authentic male display for a female; do not invent mating.

narration_timeline.text: So the shaking isn't random. It's part of the peacock's extraordinary courtship invitation.
narration_timeline.scene: End on a full fan display resolving the opening question.
